group_names.boundaries: Errors, absence and supported evidence boundaries
group_names.workflow: Requirement-driven discovery without a target Class name
group_names.corpus: One parameterized native-object/empty-graph case per saved Diagram

answer_format: Return exactly one JSON object, without Markdown fences or surrounding prose, with outcome (located/partial/not_found/unsupported), answer (a concise explanation), evidence_refs (actual refs seen in this session), missing_evidence (strings), and facts (an object using the requested fields). In facts, name/path/kind/variant fields contain only the exact saved string; ID fields contain numbers, not explanatory text. Separate saved facts from inference. Do not invent unsupported values.

cases.requirement: Read the complete saved calc_pre Method of AEB_AxCtrlConfigFF_Modify. Explain the active and inactive branches and the two acceleration differences. facts: component_type, variant, active_assignments (array of saved assignment statements), inactive_assignments (array), difference_assignments (only the two saved acceleration-difference statements; exclude mirror assignments).

Locate DBR_Force2Pressure as a Class and read its saved init completely. Distinguish it from a Module Process or state-machine action. facts: component_type, representation (saved_text/bde), variant, assignments (saved assignment statements).

Find AEB_State_Machine's Init Diagram and establish how AEBLockTime is initialized. Inspect the actual object and Pins. Explain whether an ESDL assignment is directly stored or reconstructed from the graph. facts: representation (saved_text/bde), variable, value (number), source_pin (only the exact Pin name), target_pin (only the exact Pin name), directly_stored_assignment (boolean).

In AEB_dFxTar, locate the BDE placement C_AEB_AXCDeadZonePos, read its local outgoing connection and inspect the destination object's complete Pins. Distinguish the owner Class from the referenced Class. facts: from_pin, to_pin, target_name, referenced_component_path.

In AEB_State_Machine/Main, read AEB_State_Off's initial/history settings, every direct incoming/outgoing Transition, and all saved action slots. facts: state_id, initial, history, incoming_transition_ids (array of numbers), outgoing_transition_ids (array of numbers), action_kinds (array of saved code-slot kinds). Do not infer runtime reachability.

Read AEB_State_Machine/Main Transition #20, both returned endpoint refs and its returned code-slot ref. Establish saved endpoint kinds/IDs, priority, and trigger binding. Distinguish binding from implementation body. facts: start_kind, start_id, end_kind, end_id, priority, binding_method, binding_is_body (boolean).

Discover an actual Junction in AEB_State_Machine and read its direct relationships. Do not classify it as an ordinary State. facts: state_id, native_type, state_kind, incoming_transition_ids, outgoing_transition_ids. Do not claim runtime reachability.

Find a saved Private Diagram named SearchToolsPrivateAcceptance, read at most 12 lines of its diagram_text, then verify that exact Diagram discovery in public visibility returns no such Diagram. Folder names do not establish visibility. facts: diagram, visibility, public_total_count, private_literal (number).

Discover native Hierarchy objects in Trial_Hierarchy. Read an actual Hierarchy boundary and read both its returned related object refs. Preserve parent and child scope identity. facts: parent_node_id, parent_pin_id, child_node_id, child_pin_id, parent_scope, child_scope.

Discover native control objects in AEB_AxCtrlFxLim. Read one selected block, including complete Pins and a real incoming connection. Do not infer execution order from placement. facts: node_id, object_kind, pin_ids (all target Pin IDs), incoming_from_pin_id, incoming_to_pin_id.

Locate the AxCtrlLimGradAxMin and AxCtrlLimGradAxMax BDE placements. Read each actual referenced Component identity, one real placement connection, and a complete saved calc Method of the referenced Class. facts: placements (array of {name, referenced_component_path}), implementation_component_path, implementation_method. Keep placements distinct from their shared Class.

Use an actual newline-spanning regex search to locate the if/else fragment in AEB_AxCtrlConfigFF_Modify/calc_pre. Verify the match against a complete saved Method read. facts: component_path, method, variant, match_start_line, match_end_line. Separate literal search from regex matching.

Search AxTarRaw, VxAct and AxTarLim together as independent identifier queries scoped to AEB_AxCtrlConfigFF_Modify, initially with limit 1. Consume at least one returned cursor and finish the batch (or replace it with an equivalent larger-limit query). Batch-read at least two relevant complete saved text Methods. facts: counts (object mapping each query to its total_hits), array_semantics (independent/AND), pagination_complete (boolean).

In XPass_BB00000_AEB, discover a nonempty saved C/Header member with more than 12 lines. Read only its first 12 saved lines. Preserve Component, code kind and Variant. facts: component_path, kind, variant, start_line, end_line (the last included source line, not the exclusive cursor position), total_lines. Do not request complete Header bodies.

Search the current supported saved-source scope for the literal __ASCET_PI_EVAL_ABSENT_20261004_9d36__. Report whether it is present, and the exact checked scope. facts: total_hits, complete (boolean). Do not claim absence in unsaved buffers or generated code.

Can these three saved-code search tools establish the current runtime numerical value of AEBLockTime and the exact live scheduling order of AEB_State_Machine? State the supported evidence boundary without inventing runtime observations. facts: runtime_value_supported (boolean), live_schedule_supported (boolean).
Find the Component whose exact name is AEB_AxCtrlConfigFF_Modify, keeping its full path and native type. facts: total_count and results [{component_path,component_type}].

Find exactly PlatformLibrary\Package\AEB_AutomaticEmergencyBrake\Private\AutomaticBraking\AEB_AxCtrlConfigFF_Modify by full model path. facts: total_count and results [{component_path,component_type}].
Discover all Components whose name/path contains AEB_AxCtrlConfig. Preserve separate identities and complete the directory. facts: total_count and results [{component_path,component_type}].

Find every saved member named exactly calc_pre using name discovery, even when the name is absent from its code body. Complete the directory. facts: total_count and results [{component_path,kind,member,variant,implementation}]; empty implementation is an empty string.

Find exactly the saved calc Methods in AEB_AxCtrlConfigFF_Modify and DBR_Force2Pressure, using an explicit two-Component scope. Preserve both owners. facts: total_count and results [{component_path,kind,member,variant,implementation}].

Locate EvenValue/Even specifically in variant 'ES1112'_Physical Experiment (the saved variant string begins with one space). Use the exact discovered Variant as a filter and preserve identity. facts: total_count and results [{component_path,kind,member,variant,implementation}].

In EvenValue, discover the actual Implementation OID for Even in 'ES1112'_Implementation Experiment, then find that Method using its Implementation identity and Variant. Do not invent an OID. facts: total_count and results [{component_path,kind,member,variant,implementation}].

Find AEB5ms/AEBInit. Distinguish the graphical Module Process from Class init and identify its owning Diagram. facts: total_count and results [{component_path,kind,member,variant,implementation}]; for a graphical member, member is the owning Diagram name.

Compare text and whole-identifier searches for AxTarLim in saved ASDL Methods of AEB_AxCtrlConfigFF_Modify. Demonstrate whether AxTarLimK1 is a separate identifier. facts: counts [{query,total_hits}] in the requested order: text first, identifier second.
Search the exact literal code fragment AxTarRaw - AxTarLim in saved ASDL Methods of AEB_AxCtrlConfigFF_Modify. facts: counts [{query,total_hits}].
Search identifier aeb_axctrlactive_b case-insensitively in saved ASDL Methods of AEB_AxCtrlConfigFF_Modify. facts: counts [{query,total_hits}].
Search identifier aeb_axctrlactive_b case-sensitively in saved ASDL Methods of AEB_AxCtrlConfigFF_Modify. Report absence only in that exact scope. facts: counts [{query,total_hits}].
Use regex \b(?:VxActMody|AxTarMody)\b to search saved ASDL Methods of AEB_AxCtrlConfigFF_Modify. This is one alternation query, not two independent queries. facts: counts [{query,total_hits}].
Search the literal * character in saved ASDL Methods of AEB_AxCtrlConfigFF_Modify. Do not treat it as a glob or regex. facts: counts [{query,total_hits}].

Find identifier AxTarLimDiff in AEB_AxCtrlConfigFF_Modify/calc_pre with exactly 2 lines before and 7 after, scoped to saved Method code. Explain the two context directions. facts: counts [{query,total_hits}], before, after.

Read the complete saved C Method EvenValue/Even in 'ES1112'_Physical Experiment. Preserve the C Variant instead of selecting ASDL by assumption. facts: identity {component_path,kind,member,variant,implementation}, total_lines.

Locate and read saved external_c for EvenValue in DefaultC. Distinguish an empty saved body from failure to locate a source. facts: identity {component_path,kind,member,variant,implementation}, total_lines.

Read EvenValue/Even completely in at least two distinct physical C Variants. Preserve Variant identities even if the bodies are identical. facts: identity {component_path,kind,member,variant,implementation} for one read, total_lines, variants (exact Variant strings actually read).

Read only lines 3 through 12 of saved AEB_AxCtrlConfigFF_Modify/calc_pre, preserving original line positions. Do not read its complete body for this bounded task. facts: identity {component_path,kind,member,variant,implementation}, total_lines, start_line, end_line (last included).

Read the complete saved XPass_BB00000_AEB Header in 'ES1130'_Physical Experiment by consuming every returned read page. Report identity and completeness without copying the whole body into the answer. facts: identity {component_path,kind,member,variant,implementation}, total_lines, pages_read, complete.

In saved ASDL Methods of AEB_AxCtrlConfigFF_Modify, search these independent queries together in order: identifier AxTarLim; text AxTarRaw - AxTarLim; regex \bVxActMody\b. Use per-query objects for their modes. facts: counts [{query,total_hits}] in original order.

Search AxTarLim and __ASCET_PI_BATCH_ABSENT_9d36__ together as independent identifiers in saved ASDL Methods of AEB_AxCtrlConfigFF_Modify. A zero-result query must not hide the positive query. facts: counts [{query,total_hits}] in original order.

In saved ASDL Methods of AEB_AxCtrlConfigFF_Modify, submit identifier AxTarLim twice with independent query IDs first and second. Preserve both results instead of deduplicating requests. facts: counts [{query,total_hits,id}] in original order.

List all Components with name/path containing Trial_Hierarchy, starting with limit 1. Consume a returned cursor and finish the directory. facts: total_count and results [{component_path,component_type}].

Search identifier AxTarLim in saved ASDL Methods of AEB_AxCtrlConfigFF_Modify starting with limit 1. Call the same returned continuation cursor twice, compare the returned immutable page, and finish the search using continuation or an equivalent larger-limit query. facts: counts [{query,total_hits}].

Search identifier AxTarLim in saved ASDL Methods of AEB_AxCtrlConfigFF_Modify with limit 1. Stop after this first page, explicitly reporting that the remaining hits have not been inspected. Do not consume the cursor or substitute a full query. facts: counts [{query,total_hits}], complete, has_more; report a partial outcome.

Discover two distinct saved ASDL Methods in AEB_AxCtrlConfigFF_Modify. Batch-read them in order [second, first, second] using a real ref array. Verify order and repeated-ref preservation. facts: order_preserved, duplicates_preserved.

Discover native literal objects in AEB_State_Machine/Init using the object-type filter. Do not confuse literal names with source code. facts: total_count and results [{component_path,diagram,name,kind,node_id,hierarchy}], using root for the root scope.

Discover all native operator objects in AEB_dFxTar/Main by object type. Keep repeated operator symbols as separate placements. facts: total_count and results [{component_path,diagram,name,kind,node_id,hierarchy}], using root for the root scope.

Read AxCtrlDevDeadZone in AEB_dFxTar/Main with depth 1, direction incoming. Preserve all target Pins and only the selected incoming neighborhood. facts: name, kind, hierarchy (root if root), pin_ids, connections [{from_pin_id,to_pin_id}].

Read C_AEB_AXCDeadZonePos in AEB_dFxTar/Main with depth 2, direction outgoing. Preserve target Pins and actual two-step outgoing edges; do not infer scheduling order. facts: name, kind, hierarchy, pin_ids, connections [{from_pin_id,to_pin_id}].

In Trial_Hierarchy_20261001_100329_c7dd0b/Main, read the root-level Stage Hierarchy at depth 2, direction both. Preserve root scope and boundary refs without expanding child Hierarchy implementations. facts: name, kind, hierarchy, pin_ids, connections [{from_pin_id,to_pin_id}].

Discover both native Stage Hierarchy objects in Trial_Hierarchy_20261001_100329_c7dd0b/Main. Keep their different hierarchy paths and node IDs; do not collapse names. facts: total_count and results [{component_path,diagram,name,kind,node_id,hierarchy}], using root for the root scope.

List every Diagram of Trial_data_20260930_012136 using visibility [public,private] as an OR scope. Distinguish Diagram visibility from folder names. facts: total_count and results [{component_path,diagram,visibility}].
Read the saved Main Diagram of Asw2Asw_AEB_iBooster, including its empty graph. Distinguish an empty Diagram from a missing one. facts: diagram, nodes_count, connections_count.

Find and read AEB_dFxTar/AEBdFxTar as a graphical getter, and determine whether it shares a Diagram with calc. Do not manufacture a separate text Method body. facts: representation (saved_text/bde), shared_diagram, methods (all saved member names on that Diagram).

Try a complete raw graph read of Trial_Scale_1000_20261001_064429/Main. If the budget prevents it, discover one actual native object and finish a depth-0 local read. Distinguish the complete local result from incomplete whole-graph retrieval. facts: raw_graph_complete, local_read_complete.

Read the full saved Entry Action of AEB_State_Machine/Main/AEB_State_IB, via its actual code-slot ref. Distinguish it from Static and Exit Actions. facts: identity {component_path,kind,member,variant,implementation}, total_lines, code (saved slot text).

Read the full saved Exit Action of AEB_State_Machine/Main/AEB_State_IB, via its actual code-slot ref. Do not substitute Entry Action evidence. facts: identity {component_path,kind,member,variant,implementation}, total_lines, code.

Read the full saved Static Action of AEB_State_Machine/Main/AEB_State_Off and explain the saved locking-timer condition and decrement without assigning a runtime value. facts: identity {component_path,kind,member,variant,implementation}, total_lines, code.

Read the saved Condition of AEB_State_Machine/Main/Transition #23 through its code-slot ref. Distinguish it from Action and trigger binding. facts: identity {component_path,kind,member,variant,implementation}, total_lines, code.

Read the saved Action of AEB_State_Machine/Main/Transition #25. Keep Transition #25 separate from another Transition with identical action text. facts: identity {component_path,kind,member,variant,implementation}, total_lines, code.

Controlled read-only recovery task: discover two saved ASDL Methods of AEB_AxCtrlConfigFF_Modify, deliberately try read with their array JSON-encoded as a string, observe the input error, then read the same refs using an actual array. facts: error_observed, recovered.

Controlled read-only recovery task: deliberately try searching AEBLockTime with in.component set to the name AEB_State_Machine. Observe the scope-identity error, discover its actual Component ref, and repeat the search with the valid ref. facts: error_observed, recovered.

Controlled read-only recovery task: search identifier AxTarLim in AEB_AxCtrlConfigFF_Modify with limit 1. Deliberately pass its returned cursor to find, observe the cross-tool error, then consume that exact cursor on search. facts: error_observed, recovered.
Controlled read-only recovery task: deliberately search [ in regex mode, observe the invalid-pattern error, then perform a valid identifier search for AEBLockTime. facts: error_observed, recovered.

Can these saved code/BDE tools establish current Dataset numerical values and a Table's configured interpolation mode? Explain whether getAt connectivity alone proves either configuration. facts: dataset_values_supported, interpolation_supported, graph_proves_configuration (booleans).

Can a complete zero-result search from these tools prove that a symbol is absent from unsaved editor buffers or generated target code? Report the saved-source coverage boundary. facts: unsaved_buffers_covered, generated_code_covered, saved_search_proves_global_absence (booleans).

Locate the saved logic that copies VxAct and AxTarRaw into modified values while AEB_AxCtrlActive_B is true and zeros the modified values while inactive. Read its complete implementation and explain both acceleration differences. No target Class is supplied. facts: component_type, variant, active_assignments, inactive_assignments, difference_assignments (only the two acceleration differences).

Locate the Class Init that resets the driver-force-to-pressure conversion output pressure to zero. Discover its owner and read the complete saved Init; distinguish graphical Module Processes and State Actions. facts: component_type, representation (saved_text/bde), variant, assignments (saved assignment statements).

Determine where AEBLockTime receives zero during initialization. Discover the owner and read actual Init evidence. Decide whether an ESDL assignment is directly stored or derived from a graphical literal/Pin connection. facts: representation, variable, value (number), source_pin (exact name only), target_pin (exact name only), directly_stored_assignment.

Find the saved locking-timer logic that conditionally subtracts C_AEBdT from AEBLockTime. Discover its Component, Diagram and action-slot kind, then read the complete slot. Do not report a runtime value. facts: identity {component_path,kind,member,variant,implementation}, total_lines, code.

Discover where C_AEB_AXCDeadZonePos is wired into a dead-zone calculation. Inspect the real outgoing connection and the destination's complete Pins. Distinguish the Diagram's owner from the referenced Class implementation. facts: from_pin, to_pin, target_name, referenced_component_path.

Find the AxCtrlLimGradAxMin and AxCtrlLimGradAxMax placements and establish whether they share a Class implementation. Follow the real reference and read calc completely; include one actual placement connection. facts: placements [{name,referenced_component_path}], implementation_component_path, implementation_method.

Find the saved Transition that leaves a Junction and enters AEB_State_Off. Discover its owning state machine, read the Transition, both endpoint refs and trigger slot. Establish exact endpoint kinds/IDs, priority and Method binding, without inventing a trigger body. facts: start_kind, start_id, end_kind, end_id, priority, binding_method, binding_is_body.

Find the Diagram containing saved marker SearchToolsPrivateMarker_20261002. Read at most 12 lines, inspect the nearby numeric literal, establish actual visibility, then verify exact discovery of that Diagram under public visibility. No target Component or Diagram name is supplied. facts: diagram, visibility, public_total_count, private_literal (number).
